note: Public capture failures are preserved in the original manifests. This file maps unavailable or blocked states to local reconstructed substitutes only; it does not claim recovered Apple private source, internal components, server responses, credentials, or authored design tokens.

entries.title: Mac global navigation menu substitute
entries.reason: A captured global navigation menu button on the Mac page timed out during click.
entries.limitations: Local menu open and close behavior uses observed menu labels and existing design tokens, not Apple internal navigation source.

entries.title: AirPods Heart Rate Sensing substitute
entries.reason: AirPods expansion control 65 timed out during capture.
entries.limitations: Uses named local Heart Rate Sensing disclosure content and no sensor, account, or media controller.

entries.title: AirPods Live Translation substitute

entries.title: AirPods Active Noise Cancellation substitute

entries.title: Private authoring token substitute
entries.reason: Internal design token source and authored token pipeline are not publicly available.
entries.limitations: Uses observed public CSS values and local names only.

entries.title: Private component source substitute
entries.reason: Apple internal React/Web component implementation cannot be inspected from public capture.
entries.limitations: Behavior is implemented as local React components following observed interaction shape.

entries.title: Server response substitute
entries.reason: Search, bag, product, and support server responses are private or session dependent.
entries.limitations: All data is static local sample data with no network mutation.

entries.title: Authentication state substitute
entries.reason: Real Apple Account authentication and credential flows are unavailable and should not be emulated with real fields.
entries.limitations: Demo state toggle contains no username, password, token, payment, or identity input.
